create_rich_table: create a Rich Table with custom headers and a title using rounded box styling
print_valid_options: print a list of valid options as markdown bullet points to the console
create_table_with_columns: create a Rich Table from a list of column headers and a title string
print_markdown_with_options: print markdown text appended with a bulleted list of valid options to the console
review_create_table: review the create_table function that returns a styled Rich Table with rounded borders
